name: Beyond LoD95
description: This record provides the reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript “Beyond LoD95: A False-Alarm-Controlled Benchmark for Surface-Normal Change Detection in UAV-Derived Slope Point Clouds.” The package contains the controlled benchmark generator, frozen experiment configurations, random seeds, point-cloud audit tools, derived numerical results, figure-generation scripts, unit tests, and supplementary diagnostic analyses. It supports reproduction and audit of the model-null calibration, held-out probability-of-false-alarm qualification, probability-of-detection estimation, conditional minimum detectable deformation analysis, calibration-stability assessment, and real six-epoch execution demonstration reported in the manuscript. The package does not include the original A-7 point clouds, orthophotos, or other large source products. These source data are publicly available from the related A-7 dataset record at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14135593. The numerical detection thresholds reported in the accompanying manuscript are specific to the audited A-7 slope geometry, the frozen post-reconstruction observation models, and the prespecified experimental split. The package supports methodological reproduction and auditing; it does not provide a universally applicable UAV change-detection threshold or an externally validated field-warning system.
